verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe the full loop: capturing and syncing robot data (viam-docs-7, viam-docs-28), creating/annotating datasets and training ML models in the cloud or bringing your own (viam-docs-8), and pushing trained models to the cloud with machines auto-pulling and running inference locally, including versioning/staging/rollback and canary testing (viam-docs-9, viam-docs-26, viam-docs-40). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the training-to-deployment workflow beyond first-party docs, and detail on model performance/quality after retraining.
